name: videos
description: Video pipeline for any project: a board of every video in progress, then one skill per stage (new, ingest, transcribe, rough, tighten, audio, grade, formats, master, wide, clips, qc, publish) driven by a plain-text record per video. Talking-head videos are cut once: a multicamera shoot is then laid out in HyperFrames from one all-angles master (16:9 first, the 9:16 from the same layout spans); a single-camera edit is finished as the long 9:16 in the NLE, and the 16:9 and the shorts are made from it.
